issue_types.description: URLs use http:// instead of https://.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Serve the site over HTTPS and build canonical / sitemap / Open Graph URLs from the https domain.

issue_types.description: No Content-Security-Policy header, so injected scripts run without restriction (XSS risk).
issue_types.recommended_fix: Add a CSP in next.config headers() or middleware (start with Report-Only).

issue_types.description: X-Content-Type-Options is missing or wrong, allowing MIME-type sniffing.
issue_types.recommended_fix: Add the header in next.config headers().
